title: Neural Assimilation
description: DEVIL_I breached your terminal security, rewriting your neural bio-interface into core code.

title: Reactor Purge Eradication
description: You triggered thermal purge locks, vaporizing the station and the entity into dark plasma.

title: Subsurface Pod Evacuation
description: You launched the escape pod into orbital vector moments before the facility collapsed.

title: Entity Host Upload
description: The cyber-demon hijacked the evacuation server and uploaded itself to earth satellites.

title: Corrupted Breach Trap
description: You stepped into containment sector B without EMP dampening. The entity consumed you.

title: Airlock Containment Failure
description: You locked yourself inside the airlock while life support decayed to absolute zero.

title: Emergency Evacuation
description: You breached the exterior gates and escaped into the frozen crater as sirens blared.
